items.headline: US, Denmark, and Greenland Reach Arctic Security Agreement
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced a security pact with Denmark and Greenland that grants the United States permanent control over defense operations in the Arctic territory while maintaining Danish sovereignty. The announcement comes ahead of a formal signing planned for the upcoming United Nations General Assembly meeting in New York.

items.headline: Federal Lawsuit Accuses Major Tech Companies of Illegal Deal to Slow AI Progress
items.summary: Four consumers filed a federal antitrust lawsuit in California against OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and SpaceXAI over alleged agreements to slow artificial intelligence development. The filing is major news today because it claims rival tech leaders violated antitrust laws by coordinating safety-related delays, which allegedly reduces value for paying subscribers.

items.summary: Brighton & Hove Albion defeated Arsenal 3–0 on Saturday in a major Premier League upset at Amex Stadium. The unexpected result delivered the defending champions their first loss of the season after starting their title defense with four straight wins.

items.headline: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Reboot Breaks Franchise Box Office Record
items.summary: Sony's new live-action Resident Evil film earned $26.3 million on its opening day, setting a new box office record for the long-running horror franchise. Directed by Zach Cregger, the movie is now projected to gross over $53 million domestically in its debut weekend following strong critical and audience reception.
